entities.summary: Songkhla Lake is the largest natural lake in Thailand. It is on the Malay Peninsula in Southern Thailand. Covering an area of 1,040 km2 it borders the provinces of Songkhla and Phatthalung. Despite being called a lake, it is actually a lagoon complex.
